content:
Coast to Coast AM with George Noory

An interesting game camera photo from Missouri shows a mysterious tuft of fur that just might be a glimpse of Bigfoot. The enigmatic image was showcased last week by the 'Homesteader Horsemanship' YouTube channel, which chronicles the life and adventures of a homesteader family that raises horses on their massive property in the Ozarks. Prior to sharing the photo, host JR explained that his son-in-law had placed a game camera in a remote location on the land. Shortly thereafter, they noticed that the device was repeatedly removed from the tree where it was placed and left behind on the ground without otherwise being disturbed. To the bewilderment of the family, when the game camera was disturbed again in mid-October, it snapped the puzzling picture that left them scratching their heads.

Check out the peculiar photo and find out more on this story at the Coast to Coast AM website.
